mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 56 degrees and quite foggy near the Verona Public Library. We are under a full moon, and the air quality index is currently at 52, which is in the moderate range.

Regarding city infrastructure, a portion of Hwy M near the future Aldi site will be closed from October 5 through October 7 for final paving work. This follows the ongoing phase two construction which has traffic currently shifted while shoulder work continues.
Today you can head over to Insight Wellness for yoga. Tomorrow, the town is bustling with options like Hop Haus Trivia, Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee, and Dream Day Trivia at Paddy Mac's.

In our weekly look at police activity, on September 5, officers investigated reports of vehicles with cheese slices on their windshields on East Harriet and Main Street, which turned out to be a social media prank known as the Dairy Dare.
For dessert lovers, today's featured flavor is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. Culver's of Verona opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and satisfy your sweet tooth.
